metadata.dataset: Illinois Antiquity & Places of the Past (sites list)
metadata.notes: Structured from guidebook pages; fields may include seasonal hours and may change.

sites.name: Essley-Noble Museum
sites.description: Museum exhibits include county history collections and locally recovered Native American artifacts from Mercer County.

sites.name: Marshall County Historical Society & Museum
sites.description: Museum collections include artifacts and materials related to Marshall County history, including Native American artifacts from the region.

sites.name: New Boston Historical Society Museum
sites.description: Local museum preserving regional history with displays that include artifacts from the New Boston area.

sites.name: Henderson County Museum
sites.description: Museum complex preserving rural Henderson County history, including artifacts from early settlement and local archaeological finds.

sites.name: Warren County History Museum
sites.description: County museum with exhibits on local history, including Native American artifacts and related materials from Warren County.

sites.name: Knox County Museum
sites.description: Museum located in a historic courthouse complex with exhibits of local artifacts from Knox County, including Native American materials.

sites.name: Chillicothe Historical Society Museum
sites.description: Museum exhibits interpret Chillicothe area history and include displays of Native American artifacts from the region.
sites.notes: The society operates multiple museum locations.

sites.name: Peoria Riverfront Museum
sites.description: Museum collections include archaeological specimens and exhibits on Native American and regional history in the Illinois River valley.

sites.name: Wildlife Prairie Park
sites.hours: Open daily; ticket gate 9AM-4:30PM; animal trails 9AM-4PM
sites.description: Large educational park with exhibits interpreting prairie life and regional natural history, including information on Native American presence in the area.

sites.name: Weld House Museum
sites.description: Historic house museum with exhibits covering Nauvoo history, including Native American artifacts and early settlement materials.

sites.name: Rheinberger Museum
sites.description: Housed in a restored home originally built by Mormons in the 1840s, the museum exhibits artifacts from all periods of Nauvoo’s history, from Native American occupation to the 1930s.

sites.name: LaHarpe Historical Society Museum
sites.description: Local museum preserving community history with displays of artifacts from the La Harpe area.

sites.name: Kibbe Hancock Heritage Museum
sites.description: Regional museum with collections that include archaeological materials and artifacts from Hancock County.

sites.name: Dickson Mounds Museum
sites.description: On-site archaeological museum interpreting more than 12,000 years of Native American history in the Illinois River Valley through excavated materials and exhibits.
sites.notes: Closed New Year's Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day.
